settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.text: Find answers to common questions about Print on Demand

settings.heading: How does Print on Demand work?
settings.content: When you place an order, our system automatically sends the design to our production facility. Your item is printed specially for you, which helps us reduce waste and offer a wider variety of unique designs.

settings.heading: How long does production take?
settings.content: Typically, items take 2–5 business days to be printed and processed before they are shipped. During peak holidays, production times may be slightly longer.

settings.heading: How long will it take to receive my order?
settings.content:
Shipping times depend on your location.
Domestic (US): 3–7 business days after production.

settings.heading: How do I know which size to pick?
settings.content: We provide a Size Guide on every product page. We recommend measuring a favorite garment you already own and comparing it to our charts for the best fit.

settings.heading: What printing method do you use?
settings.content: Most of our apparel is printed using DTG (Direct to Garment) technology, which allows for high-detail prints and a soft feel that integrates with the fabric.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.content: Since every item is made to order, we do not typically accept returns or exchanges for sizing issues. However, if your item arrives damaged or with a printing error, we will send a replacement at no cost to you.

settings.heading: How do I report a problem with my order?
settings.content: Please email our support team at artsbydylan@gmail.com with your order number and clear photos of the issue within 14 days of receiving your package.

settings.text: Can't find what you're looking for? Contact our support team and we'll be happy to help!
